turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy of Chennai? This is Inspector Vikram from the Cyber Cell.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Is something wrong? Why are you calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, we have intercepted a courier from Mumbai containing illegal narcotics and your Aadhaar number is linked to the sender's address.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? I have never sent any courier to Mumbai. This must be a huge mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is why we are calling, but until the verification is done, you are under digital arrest and cannot leave your house or tell anyone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Digital arrest? I don't understand this. Please, I am a retired man, let me call my son.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you disconnect or inform anyone, it will be seen as tampering with evidence and we will send a team to arrest you immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am very scared now. Please tell me how to prove that I have nothing to do with these drugs.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The court has a provision for a security clearance deposit to verify your identity and clear your name.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: A deposit? How much are you talking about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You need to transfer one lakh rupees to the government verification account immediately to avoid the arrest warrant.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh is a lot of money. Can I come to the police station instead?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, you are under digital arrest. Just send the money now and I will send you the release certificate on WhatsApp.
